podcast.body: By the end of the 2010s, "Learn to Fly" was the most streamed Foo Fighters song, accumulating around 350 million listens. Despite being one of the biggest rock acts of the last 30 years, their streaming numbers were considerably lower than pop superstars like Ed Sheeran. "By the time the decade ended, this was the most streamed Food Fighters song with around 350 million listens."
